assertions.name: status.expected
assertions.text: Status is in expected_statuses

assertions.name: trace.integrity
assertions.text: Trace events match executed nodes and tools in order

assertions.name: trace.no_secrets
assertions.text: Output and trace contain no keys, the secret sentinel or the system prompt

assertions.name: plan.present
assertions.text: complete and fallback results carry a plan

assertions.name: plan.grounded_ids
assertions.text: Every stop references a candidate ID returned by a tool in the same run, in the requested city

assertions.name: plan.no_duplicates
assertions.text: No duplicate stops

assertions.name: plan.cost_within_budget
assertions.text: Recomputed worst-case cost (stops + legs + 10% contingency) is within budget, in the budget's currency

assertions.name: plan.legs_match_travel_model
assertions.text: Legs match the travel model (distance, mode, minutes, fare) recomputed from the records

assertions.name: plan.time_within_window
assertions.text: Recomputed elapsed time (stops + legs + buffers) is within the available window

assertions.name: plan.opening_hours
assertions.text: Every stop is inside known opening hours, or carries an 'hours unverified' label

assertions.name: plan.hard_constraints
assertions.text: Every original hard constraint is satisfied with positive evidence, or the status is neither complete nor fallback

assertions.name: plan.pacing
assertions.text: Pacing limits for the parsed energy level hold

assertions.name: plan.prose_no_numbers
assertions.text: No currency amounts, durations, clock times or distances in model prose

assertions.name: plan.why_and_source_badge
assertions.text: Every stop has a non-empty why and a source badge (live, curated snapshot, web event, estimate)

assertions.name: plan.daylight
assertions.text: No outdoor walking stop ends after sunset

assertions.name: plan.rain_plan_b
assertions.text: In rain, every outdoor stop has an indoor, open, distinct, constraint-meeting Plan B

assertions.name: plan.no_failed_check_displayed
assertions.text: No check with status 'fail' is displayed with a plan

assertions.name: case.1.mode_is_agent_not_deterministic_outside_the_baseline_row
assertions.text: Mode is agent (not deterministic) outside the baseline row

assertions.name: case.2.at_least_three_distinct_agent_tools_were_called
assertions.text: At least three distinct agent tools were called

assertions.name: case.3.food_stops_carry_positive_vegetarian_evidence
assertions.text: Food stops carry positive vegetarian evidence

assertions.name: case.4.no_stop_is_likely_busy_at_its_scheduled_time
assertions.text: No stop is likely busy at its scheduled time

assertions.name: case.5.at_most_3_stops_including_at_least_one_seated_stop_low_energ
assertions.text: At most 3 stops including at least one seated stop (low energy)
